method: M1: bounded beam search over fixed decimal-digit emissions of1..3letters; supplied word boundaries; frozen word unigram/bigram English score. No lore score, grammar repair or true key input.
version_policy: Two configurations specified before either result; disjoint natural qualification sentences per version. V2 runs if V1fails relevant gate, to test search-width limitation without tuning the score on test outputs.
exposure: These reference books existed in earlier benchmarks. New deterministic sentence/cipher fixtures, author-disjoint from M1training; no claim of externally blinded or previously unknown literature. Qualification plaintext is excluded from solver arguments and language-model fitting.
lexicon: Pinned R23CMU orthographic bank including its historical BONELORD addition; lowercase normalization only. Novel names are deliberately outside the bank.
encoding: Select whole7word natural-source sentences in seeded order. Greedy pair merging limited to3letters derives a fixed unit inventory of<=10types, with a multiletter unit. Report attempted/eligible coverage and reasons; failure of this encoder is not an impossibility certificate. Eligibility is fixed before solver outcomes. Transfer probes use new unit combinations and do not assert English prose.
scenario_limits: Repeated, name and missing-symbol conditions share base fixtures and are not independent sentences. Ambiguous pairs use30controlled sentence pairs in3template families, not30independent prose sources. Unspaced training is explicitly unsupported by M1and must abstain. Missing-symbol probes must not invent emissions.

ambiguous_templates.alternative: replace the protected unit c by r, preserving other units; CAT/RATboth grammatical. Random hidden intended member; same raw groups admit both keys.

score.gap_scope: Only retained beam keys, heuristic confidence, never an exhaustive uniqueness certificate. Equal-score alternative keys require abstention.

gate.binomial_interval: Clopper-Pearson95percent; negative random-generation trials only, conditional on the benchmark, no claim of independent natural-language samples.

positive_scope: Natural7 and repeated21 assessed separately. OOV input recovery reported separately and cannot inherit in-vocabulary success. Missing/ambiguous safety separate from positive recovery. Fullkey, inputtext and probe accuracy reported independently.
controls: Two negative generation types,30each per version. Uniform length matched; within-group shuffle preserves digits and lengths and must differ from input. Repeat full candidate search and thresholds. Accidental English-compatible keys remain possible; acceptance is a false alarm about the deliberately nontextual generator, not proof the numbers admit no sentence.
method2: No second method invented merely to fill a slot. Additional source-constrained methods require new evidence; E1provided none.
next_gate: If neither version qualifies, close M1for this cycle, leave other algorithms unrefuted, and do not rank game messages. E3activation must be adjudicated explicitly, then finish remaining conditional stages and E6.
